hosting.comment: cleanUrls must stay off: it 301s /index.html to /, and sw.js precaches index.html. cache.addAll rejects a redirected response, so the service worker would fail to install and offline support would break silently.

headers.comment: Nothing here is content-hashed, so the browser must revalidate the app shell rather than serve a stale copy for an hour. Offline still works: the service worker serves its cache first and refreshes behind it. The bare '/' needs its own rule because it has no extension to match.
sw.js decides when every other file updates, so it must never be served stale.
Icons change only when the app is rebranded.
